surfaces.label: Repository integrity and public assets
surfaces.notes: Verified clean signed revision a7ede194e6f20436cc08e27621cbfed825969684, its signed audited parent, all 78 tracked files, three changed-file rereviews, 75 byte-identical inherited receipts, and five synthetic PNGs.

surfaces.label: Database source, read-only open, and copy/live boundary
surfaces.notes: Reviewed canonical path and device/inode checks, WAL sidecar rejection before SQLite, readonly/fileMustExist/query_only opens, identity pinning, copy sync fingerprints, canonical doctor WAL reporting, and synthetic regressions.

surfaces.label: Schema capabilities and query repositories
surfaces.notes: Reviewed capability-gated SQL, bound caller values, conversations, messages, analytics, sync, date handling, reactions, receipts, edits, retractions, and keyset cursors.
surfaces.riskArea: SQL injection, attribution, completeness, and snapshot integrity

surfaces.label: HTTP authentication and transport limits
surfaces.notes: Reviewed loopback bind, constant-time bearer checks before body parsing, Host/Origin allowlists, request/response limits, rate, concurrency, and deadlines.
surfaces.riskArea: Unauthorized remote access and resource exhaustion

surfaces.label: Secret files, opaque references, and lineage
surfaces.notes: Reviewed O_NOFOLLOW 0600 operator-owned regular-file loading, independent secrets, AES-GCM references, and database-lineage scoping.
surfaces.riskArea: Secret substitution and cross-archive reference reuse

surfaces.label: Foundation decoder and unified Contacts adapter
surfaces.notes: Reviewed fixed executables/scripts, no shell, minimal environment, bounded IPC, timeouts, class allowlists, Contacts authorization, and input/output limits.
surfaces.riskArea: Unsafe deserialization, subprocess abuse, and identity leakage

surfaces.label: Privacy projection, results, errors, and diagnostics
surfaces.notes: Reviewed full, redacted, and aggregate projections, forbidden-field assertions, grapheme-safe snippets, bounded summaries, safe errors, and stderr-only redacted diagnostics.

surfaces.label: Memory-only search and resource budgets
surfaces.notes: Reviewed :memory: indexing, sizing cap, exact/token/phrase/trigram behavior, literal wildcard handling, worker deadlines, decoder locks, and query budgets.
surfaces.riskArea: Persistent sensitive indexes and denial of service

surfaces.label: Package and release supply chain
surfaces.notes: Reviewed exact dependencies, shrinkwrap integrity, package allowlist, pinned Actions, permission-separated jobs, signed direct-child evidence, attestations, OIDC publication, and canary derivation.

surfaces.label: Seven-tool API, client manifests, and documentation
surfaces.notes: Reviewed exactly seven read-only registrations, MCP schemas, installed entrypoint, canonical doctor diagnostics, Claude/Codex/Cursor metadata, Android SMS/RCS boundary, privacy claims, and unsupported behavior.
surfaces.riskArea: Unexpected write capability or misleading deployment contract
